name: Chrome-Environment (V4.3)
onCreateCommand: docker system prune -a --volumes -f && docker pull ghcr.io/linuxserver/chrome:latest
postStartCommand: git pull origin main && bash .devcontainer/update-check.sh && mkdir -p ~/.chrome-data && docker rm -f chrome 2>/dev/null || true && docker run -d --name=chrome --restart=always -p 8080:3000 -v /home/vscode/.chrome-data:/config -e AUTO_LOGIN=true -e SUBFOLDER=/ -e CHROME_CLI="--disable-dev-shm-usage --disable-gpu --no-sandbox" --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --shm-size=2gb ghcr.io/linuxserver/chrome:latest
